question: Should OpenClaw accept this exact compatibility boundary: pruning already-persisted short-term entries classified as structural and widening the exported Plugin SDK skipped-reason union?
rationale: Both behaviors are intentional and plausibly correct, but they alter persisted-state treatment and a shipped external type contract; repository policy requires explicit owner judgment rather than inferring acceptance from tests or green CI.

options.title: Accept the compatibility boundary
options.body: Approve both the persisted-state pruning semantics and additive SDK reason, then require refreshed exact-head behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the reason internal
options.body: Retain centralized filtering but avoid widening the exported event union until a separately approved Plugin SDK contract change is prepared.

options.title: Narrow state normalization
options.body: Filter newly recorded and applied candidates while preserving existing recall-store entries until an explicit cleanup or migration policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the compatibility boundary
recommendation.body: Approve both the persisted-state pruning semantics and additive SDK reason, then require refreshed exact-head behavior proof before merge.
